name: cycle-wars
description: Cycle Wars: global cycling territory conquest game.

scripts.android:stop-gradle: set "JAVA_HOME=C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr"&& set "ANDROID_HOME=C:\Users\Pablo\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk"&& set "ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=C:\Users\Pablo\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk"&& set "PATH=%JAVA_HOME%\bin;%ANDROID_HOME%\platform-tools;%ANDROID_HOME%\emulator;%PATH%"&& pushd apps\mobile\android && gradlew.bat --stop & popd
scripts.android:install-clean: npm run android:purge-native-cache && npm.cmd --workspace @cycle-wars/mobile run android:install-debug
scripts.android:install-short: subst W: /D >nul 2>nul & subst W: "%CD%" && pushd W:\ && npm.cmd run android:purge-native-cache && cd apps\mobile && npm.cmd run android:install-debug & popd
scripts.quality: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run format:check && npm run smoke:static && npm run release:check
